name: Massachusetts (United States, 1908–1971)
description: White field with the state shield on the obverse: a dark blue shield bearing a green pine tree, with the arm-and-sword crest above.

features.role: shield with pine tree and arm-and-sword crest

history: Until 1971 the flag was two-sided, with the pine-tree shield obverse shown here and a plain pine tree on the reverse; the 1971 revision replaced the obverse arms on both sides.
